title: Different Groups, Different Lives
grammar: Recap: -nként for "per"; míg and ezzel szemben
goal: I can say how much or how often per person, family or group with -nként.
I can contrast two groups with míg and ezzel szemben.
I can talk about equal opportunity with four new words, such as esélyegyenlőség and munkanélküliség.
I can say that support is calculated per family.
